title: Lehman Brothers collapse (Global Financial Crisis)
summary: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy, freezing credit markets and triggering the worst global banking crisis since the 1930s.

title: The 2010 Flash Crash
summary: The Dow Jones plunged about 9% within minutes on automated/algorithmic selling before rebounding the same day.

title: S&P downgrades US credit rating
summary: S&P cut the United States' credit rating from AAA to AA+ for the first time ever, amid a debt-ceiling standoff, roiling global markets.

title: The Taper Tantrum
summary: Fed chair Bernanke signalled the central bank would start reducing (tapering) bond purchases, sending bond yields sharply higher.

title: 2014 oil price collapse
summary: OPEC declined to cut output amid a global supply glut, sending crude oil prices down roughly 50% over the following months.

title: 2015 China devaluation selloff ("Black Monday")
summary: China's surprise yuan devaluation and slowing growth fears triggered a sharp global equity selloff.

title: Brexit referendum
summary: The UK voted to leave the European Union; the pound had its worst one-day drop in decades and global equities sold off sharply.

title: "Volmageddon" volatility spike
summary: A sudden VIX spike blew up short-volatility products and triggered a fast, sharp equity drawdown.

title: Q4 2018 rate-fear selloff
summary: Fear of continued Fed rate hikes plus trade-war tension pushed the S&P 500 to the brink of a bear market by Christmas Eve.

title: COVID-19 crash begins
summary: Fears of a global pandemic triggered the fastest bear market in stock market history, alongside a commodity and oil demand collapse.

title: COVID crash bottom / Fed unlimited QE
summary: Markets bottomed as the Federal Reserve announced open-ended quantitative easing and emergency lending programs.

title: Oil futures turn negative
summary: WTI crude oil futures briefly traded below zero for the first time ever, as pandemic demand collapse overwhelmed storage capacity.

title: 2021 inflation surge
summary: Inflation readings hit multi-decade highs, and the Fed began signalling a hawkish policy pivot away from pandemic-era stimulus.

title: 2022 Fed rate-hiking cycle begins
summary: The Federal Reserve began an aggressive rate-hiking cycle to fight inflation, pressuring both bonds and equities through the year.

title: FTX exchange collapse
summary: The FTX crypto exchange collapsed into bankruptcy amid fraud allegations, triggering a crypto-wide crisis of confidence.

title: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
summary: Silicon Valley Bank failed in the fastest bank run in US history, sparking a regional-banking crisis and a flight to safe-haven assets.
